name: print-social-green-hiring-portrait-post-with-white-card-and-lime-megaphones
title: Green 'We Are Hiring!' portrait post with a white rounded card and two lime megaphones
whatItIs: A portrait green post with a white rounded card holding a dark green headline panel ('We Are Hiring! Join Our CREATIVE & Professional Team!' with lime 'CREATIVE'), a lime 'Open Positions' speech tab over green role bars, CV email, and two black-and-lime megaphones poking out of the card edges, with 'Apply now' and WhatsApp in the footer.
whatItMeans: Fresh and upbeat; megaphones bursting out of the card add energy.
techniques: Let 3D props break out of the card edges.
Nest a dark headline panel inside a white card.
Keep one green family with a lime accent.

vocabulary.definition: An object overlapping a container's edge.
